findings.title: Fallback palette hardcodes light mode
findings.message: When theme.Palette is unset, the selected calendar cell is styled from a light-mode palette with a fixed accent, regardless of the app's actual dark/light appearance. In dark mode, or with a custom accent, the selection colors would be wrong.
findings.suggestion: Resolve the palette from the active theme and skip the override when none is set, or derive dark mode from the theme instead of hardcoding false.

finding.title: Disabled calendar cells now carry navigation metadata
finding.message: The day style sets Border width 2 with a zero (transparent) color and CornerRadius 16 on a 24x24 cell, and the disabled cells now carry CalendarCell metadata. The ValidateControl relaxation allows disabled cells whose IDs entry is empty, but a disabled cell whose ids[i]=='' still passes only because of the new rule. Disabled cells previously carried no metadata and the validation previously rejected disabled nodes; the semantic loosening could let stale metadata through for a disabled node with an empty ID slot.
finding.suggestion: Add tests that cover disabled cells with navigation metadata, and verify that keyboard navigation (Neighbor) skips empty entries.
